/: Zedu is an AI-powered platform for bootcamps, schools and learning communities: organised cohorts, live classes, shared files and messages in one workspace.
/pricing: Zedu pricing: a free Starter plan for up to 3 cohorts, Pro at ₦20K a month with unlimited cohorts, and Enterprise with security tools and custom onboarding.
/about: Zedu was built to give educators and learning teams organised, distraction-free communication for modern cohorts, with AI that assists rather than replaces.
/products/channels: Zedu Channels organise discussions by course, cohort or topic, with threaded replies and announcements, so questions and updates never get lost in a group chat.
/products/buzz: Zedu Buzz starts a voice conversation inside any channel in one click, with no scheduling, and leaves an AI summary of the session behind when it ends.
/products/file-management: Zedu File Management stores, shares and searches files across courses and cohorts, with per-file sharing inside channels and access controls that you set.
/solutions/bootcamps: Run bootcamp cohorts on Zedu: focused channels for each cohort, live Buzz sessions, shared files and threaded feedback that mentors can follow in one place.
/solutions/schools: Give teachers and students one place for lessons, assignments and school-wide updates, with organised channels instead of scattered group chats losing messages.
/solutions/universities: Connect departments, lecturers and students with organised course channels, searchable discussions and AI-assisted learning workflows across the institution.
/download: Download the Zedu app for iOS and Android to join classes, chat with peers, share files and keep up with your cohort from your phone, wherever you are.
